review_method: Codex manual BAN/cadastre source and rendered map inspection; no agent runs or model API calls

selection.rationale: The department BAN export contains exact same number/street in Gif-sur-Yvette (91272) and Saint-Aubin (91538). Only the Gif row links BK0099. The Saint-Aubin row has no parcel oracle and is not used to invent a forbidden parcel id.
selection.query: exact BAN id from department CSV

limitations: Current BAN and cadastre snapshot, not a historical 2021 parcel-ownership record.
Parcel address links and geometry do not establish land ownership, legal public frontage or access easements.
visual_review: Saved map.png actually inspected with tools.view_image on 2026-10-17.
